thread:
sara (cs): Heads-up: Greenline and Architext onboarding projects are still stuck in indexing after last night's embedding backfill. Their kickoff demos are at risk. We need a short customer note (non-technical), ETA, and a compensation offer we can send ASAP.
amanda (cs lead): Agreed. Keep it empathetic and include a clear next step. Who can give a 2-3 line plain-English RCA + current ETA?
jon (eng): Short RCA: a recent scheduler tweak removed a safety throttle, which let shard workers scale past intended concurrency. One EU node experienced transient IO pressure which triggered retries and slowed completion for a small set of tenants. Remediation: paused the backfill, stopped retry loops, cleared the affected node cache, and restarted a rate-limited backfill. ETA: most affected projects should finish within ~18-24 hours under rate-limited progress. Targeted expedited reindex for a single tenant is available (1-2h) on request.
mike (ops): Confirmed timeline. Paused at 02:00 UTC, resumed rate-limited at 05:10 UTC (~30% throughput). If CS approves a prioritized warm-path run for Greenline we can finish in ~90 minutes; ops will require explicit sign-off.
amanda (cs lead): Draft customer message (short):

"Hi <Customer name>,

Quick update from Redwood: during a scheduled indexing job last night, a change unintentionally removed an internal safety throttle which led to retries on an EU node and slowed indexing for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We paused the job, fixed the retry behavior, and resumed a rate-limited backfill.

Status & ETA: your project is actively reindexing. We expect indexing to complete within ~18-24 hours. If you need demo-ready results sooner, reply here and we will run a prioritized expedited reindex (finishes in ~1-2 hours) and cover the cost for trial customers.

Compensation: because this affected your kickoff, were applying two weeks of complimentary Dedicated credits to your account and can schedule a 1:1 walk-through with our engineering team before your demo.

Apologies for the disruption 9– Amanda (Customer Success)"

sara (cs): That tone is good. Jon 9— is the wording OK? Avoiding deep infra details.
jon (eng): Yes. "internal safety throttle" is high-level and fine.
amanda (cs lead): I'll send this to Greenline + Architext now and cc sara + eng. Also adding a note to the AE and flagging renewal risk for Greenline. Will paste the outbound copy here after send.
incident-bot: Incident filed: INC-2026-0924 9— Embedding backfill IO pressure (EU). Severity: P3. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0924
mike (ops): One ops note: if Greenline asks for the expedited run, confirm here and ops will start warm-path and report back with a completion timestamp (~1-2h).
sara (cs): Let's hold expedited runs unless requested. Amanda, add to customer-health: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=18-24h, Compensation=2 weeks Dedicated credits, Owner=amanda. Escalate to P2 if >24h or new 5xx spikes.
amanda (cs lead): Done. Message sent to customers; pasted outbound below. Will update this thread with any replies and requests for prioritized runs. :thumbsup:
